content:
**Design doc**: .design/llm-moderation-assist.md
**Implements**: REQ-B (LlmRecommendation), REQ-E1 (queue table), REQ-F1 (audit cols), REQ-S7 (global pause); AC-3, AC-4, AC-5

**Files to add**:
- polaris-backend/migrations/00000000000048_observations_llm_recommendation.sql — extend the observations type enum
- polaris-backend/migrations/00000000000049_pending_auto_actions.sql — new table
- polaris-backend/migrations/00000000000050_actions_autonomous_audit_columns.sql — actor_kind, llm_observation_id, model, model_version, prompt_template_id, recommendation_confidence, input_hash
- polaris-backend/migrations/00000000000051_global_autonomous_pause.sql — singleton table or polaris_setup_state column

**Files to modify**:
- polaris-types/src/observation.rs — add LlmRecommendation variant to ObservationKind enum
- polaris-backend/src/repo/observation.rs — handle the new variant

**Rust quality**:
- pending_auto_actions.recommended_action JSONB stores the full RecommendedAction shape; round-trip-tested via serde
- pending_auto_actions.cited_policy_versions JSONB carries [{identifier, version}] snapshot
- New actions columns default to NULL for existing rows; only autonomous-emitted rows populate them
- ON DELETE CASCADE from incidents to pending_auto_actions (queue draft dies with its case)

**Tests**:
- tests/llm_recommendation_observation.rs — insert + read round-trip via ObservationKind::LlmRecommendation

**Blocked by**: #223 (workbook foundation provides mod_policies that pending_auto_actions.cited_policy_versions references)
